channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Your all-week, all-access pass awaits — don’t miss out
item.description: Stats, scores and schedules are always free, but this week, nonsubscribers can enjoy all Strib Varsity has to offer.

item.title: There’s gold in that there river, say Minnesota treasure hunters
item.description: Meet the prospectors who are finding the precious yellow metal in the Mississippi River.

item.title: Twins sign veteran first baseman Josh Bell to one-year contract
item.description: Bell, a 33-year-old switch hitter, hit .237 with 22 homers and 63 RBI in 140 games with the Washington Nationals last season.

item.title: Meet the Minnesotans who are headed to the 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy
item.description: Two curling teams based in Minnesota, and the newest member of the Minnesota Wild, have earned spots at the Milan-Cortina Games, which begin in February.

item.title: Minnesota’s paid leave policy launches next month. Here’s what to know.
item.description: Workers are entitled to 12 weeks of leave for a new baby, an illness or to care for a loved one.

item.title: Hundreds of St. Paul students stay home to oppose Hmong program overcrowding
item.description: The school district is facing pressure to ease overcrowding at a popular Hmong dual language and culture school, Txuj Ci.

item.title: Vikings outside linebacker Jonathan Greenard to undergo season-ending shoulder surgery
item.description: Greenard aggravated a shoulder injury he suffered against the Ravens during Sunday night’s win over the Cowboys.

item.title: Medical facilities improperly disposing body parts and bandages at municipal waste facility
item.description: Ramsey-Washington Recycling and Energy said sending infectious waste to municipal waste facilities violates state law and poses health and safety risks for workers.

item.title: Robbinsdale district to close three schools, district headquarters
item.description: Parents and teachers said the decision felt rushed. District leaders say choices had to be made now for a state-mandated debt plan.

item.title: At least 4 detained, protesters and agents clash in latest ICE operation in metro
item.description: As the Department of Homeland Security steps up immigration enforcement in Minnesota, arrests and other confrontations have been popping up in more locations.
